records.context: **A softmax is not a probability.** Everything here is called an uncertainty *score*, never a confidence. Modern networks are badly calibrated — typically over-confident, and more so the deeper they are (Guo et al., 2017) — so a 0.87 from the head is not "87 % sure". The scores are used for one thing only: putting extracted image regions in an order. Nothing in this module reports a calibrated probability, and neither should anything built on it. See :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A softmax is not a probability.** Everything here is called an uncertainty *score*, never a confidence. Modern networks are badly calibrated — typically over-confident, and more so the deeper they are (Guo et al., 2017) — so a 0.87 from the head is not "87 % sure". The scores are used for one thing only: putting crops in an order. Nothing in this module reports a calibrated probability, and neither should anything built on it. See :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`.
records.translation: **softmax는 확률이 아닙니다.** 여기서는 모든 것을 신뢰도가 아니라 불확실성 *점수*라고 부릅니다. 현대 신경망은 보정이 나쁘며 — 일반적으로 과신하고, 깊을수록 더 그렇습니다(Guo et al., 2017) — 따라서 헤드가 내는 0.87은 "87 % sure"가 아닙니다. 점수는 오직 한 가지 용도, 즉 크롭에 순서를 매기는 데만 사용됩니다. 이 모듈의 어떤 것도 보정된 확률을 보고하지 않으며, 이를 기반으로 만든 어떤 것도 그래서는 안 됩니다. :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`를 참조하십시오.

records.context: **The two head shapes are handled separately.** The machine-learning classification model head emits either a single logit (binary; needs a sigmoid) or C logits (multiclass; needs a softmax) — see :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`. Pushing a single-logit column through a softmax yields a column of 1.0 and destroys the ordering; pushing C logits through a sigmoid can *invert* it. Both are silent failures that produce a confident-looking work list full of nonsense, so :func:`probabilities_from_logits` branches on the shape and the tests pin both directions.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The two head shapes are handled separately.** The classifier head emits either a single logit (binary; needs a sigmoid) or C logits (multiclass; needs a softmax) — see :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`. Pushing a single-logit column through a softmax yields a column of 1.0 and destroys the ordering; pushing C logits through a sigmoid can *invert* it. Both are silent failures that produce a confident-looking queue full of nonsense, so :func:`probabilities_from_logits` branches on the shape and the tests pin both directions.
records.translation: **두 가지 헤드 형태는 따로 처리됩니다.** 분류기 헤드는 단일 로짓(이진, sigmoid 필요) 또는 C개의 로짓(다중 클래스, softmax 필요)을 출력합니다 — :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`를 참조하십시오. 단일 로짓 열을 softmax에 통과시키면 1.0으로 채워진 열이 나와 순서가 파괴되고, C개의 로짓을 sigmoid에 통과시키면 순서가 *뒤집힐* 수 있습니다. 둘 다 그럴듯해 보이지만 엉터리로 가득한 큐를 만드는 조용한 실패이므로, :func:`probabilities_from_logits`는 형태에 따라 분기하며 테스트가 두 방향을 모두 고정합니다.

records.context: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain extracted image regions on a real laboratory microplate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two microplate sample positions — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the annotation work list is diversified by default (round-robin across microplate sample positions) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many microplate sample positions the annotation work list actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain crops on a real plate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two wells — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the queue is diversified by default (round-robin across wells) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many wells the queue actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.translation: **순수한 불확실성 순위는 피처 공간의 한 영역으로 몰립니다.** 실제 플레이트에서 가장 불확실한 크롭 100개는 흔히 같은 두 웰에서 나온 거의 동일한 사본 100개입니다 — 하나의 모호함을 백 번 레이블링하여 한 번 레이블링한 것과 거의 같은 정보를 얻는 셈입니다. 따라서 큐는 기본적으로 다양화되며(웰 간 라운드 로빈), :func:`format_queue_summary`는 큐가 실제로 몇 개의 웰을 포함하는지 출력합니다. 그 대가는 :func:`build_queue`에 분명히 명시되어 있습니다.

records.source: On **two classes this is a linear transform of** :func:`least_confidence` — ``1 − (p₁ − p₂) = 2·(1 − max p)`` — so the two produce the identical order and the identical ties. records.translation: **두 클래스에서는 이것이 다음의 선형 변환입니다:** :func:`least_confidence` — ``1 − (p₁ − p₂) = 2·(1 − max p)`` — 따라서 둘은 동일한 순서와 동일한 동점을 만들어 냅니다. C ≥ 3이 되기 전까지 이 둘은 두 가지가 아니라 하나의 선택이며, 그 경우 margin은 2위 아래의 모든 것을, least-confidence는 1위 아래의 모든 것을 무시합니다.

records.translation: 1. ``annotation_column``의 모든 레이블로 모델을 적합합니다; 2. **그룹화된** 홀드아웃 분할에서 점수를 매기므로, 그 숫자는 190개 레이블이 한 웰에서 나왔기 때문에 생긴 인위적 결과가 아닙니다; 3. 클래스별 확률을 ``png_list``에 :data:`ROUND_PRED_PREFIX` 열로 다시 기록하며, :func:`build_queue`는 이를 이전의 ``pred``보다 우선 사용합니다 — 따라서 다음 큐는 실제로 다시 순위가 매겨집니다; 4. 라운드를 기록하여 :func:`learning_curve`에 점을 하나 더 제공합니다; 5. 지금까지의 곡선에 대한 :class:`StoppingVerdict`를 반환합니다.

records.context: **Labels, not rounds, are the unit of cost.** A round is whatever size the annotator felt like; "no improvement for 3 rounds" says nothing when the rounds were 5, 300 and 8 labels. records.source: **Labels, not rounds, are the unit of cost.** A round is whatever size the annotator felt like; "no improvement for 3 rounds" says nothing when the rounds were 5, 300 and 8 labels. The thing being spent is human attention, one crop at a time, so the window is measured in crops.
records.translation: **비용의 단위는 라운드가 아니라 레이블입니다.** 라운드의 크기는 어노테이터 마음대로입니다. 라운드가 5, 300, 8개 레이블이었다면 "no improvement for 3 rounds"는 아무것도 말해 주지 않습니다. 소비되는 것은 크롭 하나하나에 드는 사람의 주의력이므로, 구간은 크롭 수로 측정됩니다.

records.context: **It refuses to answer early.** Below ``label_window`` labels since the first recorded round there is no window to measure, and a rule that fired anyway would tell people to stop after their first twelve labels.

records.source: **It refuses to answer early.** Below ``label_window`` labels since the first recorded round there is no window to measure, and a rule that fired anyway would tell people to stop after their first twelve labels.
records.translation: **너무 이르면 답을 거부합니다.** 첫 번째로 기록된 라운드 이후 레이블이 ``label_window``개 미만이면 측정할 구간이 없으며, 그래도 작동하는 규칙은 사람들에게 처음 열두 개의 레이블 후에 멈추라고 말하게 됩니다.

Flat *is* still the recommendation — if more labels are not moving a number you can measure, they are not buying anything you can demonstrate — but the reason says the held-out set is too small to prove convergence, which is a different piece of work.

records.source: Selection proceeds in three stages:
records.translation: 선택은 세 단계로 진행됩니다.

records.context: 1. :func:`wells_for_coefficient` identifies microplate sample positions with a non-zero fraction of the guide or gene. Gene-level selection sums guide fractions by default; :func:`select_montage_per_guide` evaluates guides separately. 2. :func:`score_window` defines ``target = baseline + effect`` and retains objects within ``half_widths`` robust scales of the target, ordered by ``|score - target|``. The baseline and scale are calculated across the supplied object population rather than separately for each gene. 3. :func:`objects_to_show` selects ``round(n_objects_in_well * guide_fraction_in_well)`` objects from each microplate sample position. Zero-contribution microplate sample positions remain in the plan for reporting.
records.label: spacr.cell_montage#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. :func:`wells_for_coefficient` identifies wells with a non-zero fraction of the guide or gene. Gene-level selection sums guide fractions by default; :func:`select_montage_per_guide` evaluates guides separately. 2. :func:`score_window` defines ``target = baseline + effect`` and retains objects within ``half_widths`` robust scales of the target, ordered by ``|score - target|``. The baseline and scale are calculated across the supplied object population rather than separately for each gene. 3. :func:`objects_to_show` selects ``round(n_objects_in_well * guide_fraction_in_well)`` objects from each well. records.translation: 1. :func:`wells_for_coefficient`는 가이드 또는 유전자의 비율이 0이 아닌 웰을 식별합니다. 유전자 수준 선택은 기본적으로 가이드 비율을 합산하며, :func:`select_montage_per_guide`는 가이드를 따로 평가합니다. 2. :func:`score_window`는 ``target = baseline + effect``를 정의하고 목표값에서 ``half_widths`` 로버스트 척도 이내에 있는 객체를 ``|score - target|`` 순으로 유지합니다. 기준값과 척도는 유전자마다 따로가 아니라 제공된 객체 모집단 전체에 대해 계산됩니다. 3. :func:`objects_to_show`는 각 웰에서 ``round(n_objects_in_well * guide_fraction_in_well)``개의 객체를 선택합니다. 기여가 0인 웰도 보고를 위해 계획에 남습니다.

records.source: Reads ``png_list`` -- which is where :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions` writes the per-object classification score -- and hands it to :func:`spacr.io.crop_rows_from_png_list`, which is the join that recovers ``path_name`` and the integer ``object_label`` a merged crop is cut by. So the frame that comes back serves **both** crop sources: ``png_path`` for :class:`~spacr.crops.PngCropSource`, ``path_name`` plus ``object_label`` for :class:`~spacr.crops.MergedCropSource`.
records.translation: ``png_list``를 읽고 -- :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`가 객체별 분류 점수를 기록하는 곳입니다 -- 이를 :func:`spacr.io.crop_rows_from_png_list`에 넘깁니다. 이 함수는 병합 크롭을 잘라 내는 기준인 ``path_name``과 정수 ``object_label``을 복구하는 조인입니다. 따라서 반환되는 프레임은 **두** 크롭 소스 모두에 쓰입니다. ``png_path``는 :class:`~spacr.crops.PngCropSource`에, ``path_name``과 ``object_label``은 :class:`~spacr.crops.MergedCropSource`에 쓰입니다.

records.context: This module converts vendor image files into a layout spaCR can read. It is **decoupled from the mask workflow**: nothing here imports torch, cellpose or :mod:`spacr.core`, so it can be executed, tested and previewed on a laptop with no GPU and no segmentation settings in sight.

records.source: This module converts vendor image files into a layout spaCR can read. It is **decoupled from the mask pipeline**: nothing here imports torch, cellpose or :mod:`spacr.core`, so it can be run, tested and previewed on a laptop with no GPU and no segmentation settings in sight.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 제조사 이미지 파일을 spaCR가 읽을 수 있는 레이아웃으로 변환합니다. **마스크 파이프라인과 분리되어 있습니다**. 여기서는 torch, cellpose, :mod:`spacr.core`를 전혀 가져오지 않으므로, GPU도 분할 설정도 없는 노트북에서 실행, 테스트, 미리 보기를 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: **Z that is not silently flattened.** ``convert_to_yokogawa`` max-projects unconditionally in three of its four branches (ND2, LIF, and both the 3-D and 4-D TIFF cases), and says so nowhere in its output. Here the default is :data:`Z_KEEP` — every image layer is written with its own ``Z##`` — and choosing to project is an explicit ``z_handling='max'``, announced in the plan and recorded per row in the map file.
records.label: spacr.convert#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Z that is not silently flattened.** ``convert_to_yokogawa`` max-projects unconditionally in three of its four branches (ND2, LIF, and both the 3-D and 4-D TIFF cases), and says so nowhere in its output. Here the default is :data:`Z_KEEP` — every plane is written with its own ``Z##`` — and choosing to project is an explicit ``z_handling='max'``, announced in the plan and recorded per row in the map file.
records.translation: **조용히 평탄화되지 않는 Z.** ``convert_to_yokogawa``는 네 분기 중 세 분기(ND2, LIF, 그리고 3차원 및 4차원 TIFF 경우 모두)에서 무조건 최대 투영을 수행하며, 출력 어디에서도 그렇다고 밝히지 않습니다. 여기서는 기본값이 :data:`Z_KEEP`이며 — 모든 평면이 자체 ``Z##``로 기록됩니다 — 투영을 선택하려면 명시적으로 ``z_handling='max'``를 지정해야 하며, 이는 계획에 공지되고 매핑 파일에 행별로 기록됩니다.

records.source: Design rules
records.translation: 설계 규칙

records.context: **No new required dependencies.** ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif`` are probed with :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`; when one is missing the affected files are reported as skipped with the package name and the ``pip install`` line, never as an ImportError traceback.
records.label: spacr.convert#12
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **No new required dependencies.** ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif`` are probed with :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`; when one is missing the affected files are reported as skipped with the package name and the ``pip install`` line, never as an ImportError traceback.
records.translation: **새로운 필수 의존성이 없습니다.** ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif``는 :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`으로 존재 여부를 확인합니다. 하나가 없으면 해당 파일은 ImportError 트레이스백이 아니라 패키지 이름과 ``pip install`` 줄과 함께 건너뛴 것으로 보고됩니다.

records.context: **Never overwrite.** Two sources landing on one target name is a *plan-time error* naming both, not a last-writer-wins at convert time. An output that already exists on disk is skipped and counted, so a repeat execution is a no-op rather than a silent rewrite.
records.label: spacr.convert#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Never overwrite.** Two sources landing on one target name is a *plan-time error* naming both, not a last-writer-wins at convert time. An output that already exists on disk is skipped and counted, so a re-run is a no-op rather than a silent rewrite.
records.translation: **절대 덮어쓰지 않습니다.** 두 소스가 하나의 대상 이름에 도달하는 것은 변환 시점에 마지막 작성자가 이기는 것이 아니라, 둘 다 명시하는 *계획 시점 오류*입니다. 디스크에 이미 존재하는 출력은 건너뛰고 계수되므로, 재실행은 조용한 재작성이 아니라 아무 작업도 하지 않는 것이 됩니다.

records.context: **Atomic writes.** Every TIFF is written to a temp file in the destination and :func:`os.replace`\ d into place, so an interrupted run leaves no half-written file that the next run mistakes for done.
records.label: spacr.convert#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Atomic writes.** Every TIFF is written to a temp file in the destination and :func:`os.replace`\ d into place, so an interrupted run leaves no half-written file that the next run mistakes for done.
records.translation: **원자적 쓰기.** 모든 TIFF는 대상 위치의 임시 파일에 기록된 뒤 :func:`os.replace`\ 로 제자리에 옮겨지므로, 중단된 실행은 다음 실행이 완료된 것으로 착각할 반쯤 기록된 파일을 남기지 않습니다.

Image Lab stores ``zero_is="white"`` data, so such an image is inverted as ``data_ceiling - raw``; the result then looks like Image Lab's own PDF and TIFF exports (dark objects on a light background). ``zero_is="black"`` data is returned as stored.

records.source: Pure numpy and the standard library: the file is a MIME multipart document whose ``ScanImageTagN`` parts each hold raw ``ImageData`` (width x height uint16 in the stated endianness) and an XML ``ImageHeader``. Image Lab stores ``zero_is="white"`` data, so such an image is inverted as ``data_ceiling - raw``; the result then looks like Image Lab's own PDF and TIFF exports (dark objects on a light background). ``zero_is="black"`` data is returned as stored.
records.translation: 순수 numpy와 표준 라이브러리만 사용합니다. 이 파일은 MIME 멀티파트 문서이며, 각 ``ScanImageTagN`` 부분에는 원시 ``ImageData``(명시된 엔디언의 width x height uint16)와 XML ``ImageHeader``가 들어 있습니다. Image Lab은 ``zero_is="white"`` 데이터를 저장하므로, 그러한 이미지는 ``data_ceiling - raw``로 반전됩니다. 그러면 결과는 Image Lab 자체의 PDF 및 TIFF 내보내기와 같이 보입니다(밝은 배경 위의 어두운 객체). ``zero_is="black"`` 데이터는 저장된 그대로 반환됩니다.

records.context: An imaging screen is mostly intermediates. ``stack/`` is the raw files re-shaped, ``merged/`` is ``stack/`` with the masks concatenated on, ``data/`` is one PNG per object, and a laboratory microplate that arrives as 40 GB of TIFFs leaves 400 GB behind. This module reports where the space in a project is used, and clears derived data without touching the raw microscope images, which cannot be regenerated.
records.label: spacr.data_manager#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: An imaging screen is mostly intermediates. ``stack/`` is the raw files re-shaped, ``merged/`` is ``stack/`` with the masks concatenated on, ``data/`` is one PNG per object, and a plate that arrives as 40 GB of TIFFs leaves 400 GB behind. This module reports where the space in a project is used, and clears derived data without touching the raw microscope images, which cannot be regenerated.
records.translation: 이미징 스크린은 대부분 중간 산출물입니다. ``stack/``은 원시 파일의 형태를 바꾼 것이고, ``merged/``는 ``stack/``에 마스크를 이어 붙인 것이며, ``data/``는 객체당 PNG 하나이므로, 40 GB의 TIFF 파일로 도착한 플레이트는 400 GB를 남깁니다. 이 모듈은 프로젝트에서 공간이 어디에 쓰이는지 보고하고, 다시 생성할 수 없는 원시 현미경 이미지는 건드리지 않은 채 유도된 데이터를 지웁니다.

records.context: 1. the registry knows it — anything unregistered is never a candidate; 2. its kind is not an **original** (:data:`ORIGINAL_KINDS`): nothing in :mod:`spacr.ports` declares that it produces raw images or sequencing reads, so nothing can make them again; 3. a declared **producing module** exists for its kind, and the module the registry recorded is one of them; 4. that module's **inputs are complete** — every recorded input artifact is still registered and still on disk, and :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` says the module could execute in this project right now; 5. it was written by a processing session that **finished** (``status == "complete"``); 6. what is on disk still **fingerprints to what was registered**, so a folder somebody has since dropped a file into is not prunable; 7. it lives **inside the project**, reached without following a symlink; 8. **every** artifact sharing its path passes all of the above — three kinds live in ``measurements.db``, and deleting the file for one of them destroys the other two; 9. no other registered artifact sits inside it or around it, because the bytes belong to the innermost one and a plan must not under-report what it deletes.
records.label: spacr.data_manager#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. the registry knows it — anything unregistered is never a candidate; 2. its kind is not an **original** (:data:`ORIGINAL_KINDS`): nothing in :mod:`spacr.ports` declares that it produces raw images or sequencing reads, so nothing can make them again; 3. a declared **producing module** exists for its kind, and the module the registry recorded is one of them; 4. that module's **inputs are complete** — every recorded input artifact is still registered and still on disk, and :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` says the module could run in this project right now; 5. it was written by a run that **finished** (``status == "complete"``); 6. what is on disk still **fingerprints to what was registered**, so a folder somebody has since dropped a file into is not prunable; 7. it lives **inside the project**, reached without following a symlink; 8. **every** artifact sharing its path passes all of the above — three kinds live in ``measurements.db``, and deleting the file for one of them destroys the other two; 9. no other registered artifact sits inside it or around it, because the bytes belong to the innermost one and a plan must not under-report what it deletes.
records.translation: 1. 레지스트리가 알고 있어야 합니다 — 등록되지 않은 것은 결코 후보가 아닙니다; 2. 그 종류가 **원본**(:data:`ORIGINAL_KINDS`)이 아니어야 합니다. :mod:`spacr.ports`의 어떤 것도 원시 이미지나 시퀀싱 리드를 생성한다고 선언하지 않으므로, 어떤 것도 이를 다시 만들 수 없습니다; 3. 그 종류에 대해 선언된 **생성 모듈**이 존재하고, 레지스트리에 기록된 모듈이 그중 하나여야 합니다; 4. 그 모듈의 **입력이 완전해야** 합니다 — 기록된 모든 입력 아티팩트가 여전히 등록되어 있고 디스크에 있으며, :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready`가 그 모듈을 지금 이 프로젝트에서 실행할 수 있다고 판단해야 합니다; 5. **완료된** 실행이 기록한 것이어야 합니다(``status == "complete"``); 6. 디스크에 있는 것의 지문이 여전히 **등록된 것과 일치해야** 하므로, 이후 누군가 파일을 넣은 폴더는 정리 대상이 아닙니다; 7. 심볼릭 링크를 따라가지 않고 도달하는 **프로젝트 내부**에 있어야 합니다; 8. 같은 경로를 공유하는 **모든** 아티팩트가 위 조건을 모두 통과해야 합니다 — ``measurements.db``에는 세 종류가 있으며, 그중 하나를 위해 파일을 삭제하면 나머지 둘이 파괴됩니다; 9. 다른 등록된 아티팩트가 그 안이나 그 주변에 있지 않아야 합니다. 바이트는 가장 안쪽 아티팩트에 속하며, 계획이 삭제하는 양을 과소 보고해서는 안 되기 때문입니다.

records.source: Anything that fails any of those is kept, and :attr:`PrunePlan.kept` says which rule kept it.  Unknown provenance always means keep.

records.context: Rule 3 also protects other kinds. ``ports.producers_of`` is empty for ``raw-images`` and ``sequencing-reads``, which is *why* originals are safe — and it is empty today for ``channel-stacks`` too, so ``stack/`` is reported as unregistered bytes and never offered, even though it is one of the largest intermediates. This changes only when a port declares that it produces them.
records.label: spacr.data_manager#12
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Rule 3 also protects other kinds. ``ports.producers_of`` is empty for ``raw-images`` and ``sequencing-reads``, which is *why* originals are safe — and it is empty today for ``channel-stacks`` too, so ``stack/`` is reported as unregistered bytes and never offered, even though it is one of the largest intermediates. This changes only when a port declares that it produces them.
records.translation: 규칙 3은 다른 종류도 보호합니다. ``ports.producers_of``는 ``raw-images``와 ``sequencing-reads``에 대해 비어 있으며, 이것이 원본이 안전한 *이유*입니다 — 그리고 현재는 ``channel-stacks``에 대해서도 비어 있으므로, ``stack/``은 가장 큰 중간 산출물 중 하나인데도 등록되지 않은 바이트로 보고되며 결코 제시되지 않습니다. 이는 어떤 포트가 이를 생성한다고 선언할 때만 바뀝니다.

records.context: Nothing is deleted without a plan.  :func:`plan_prune` returns exactly what would go and how much it frees; :func:`prune` refuses to run unless it is handed :attr:`PrunePlan.token`, a digest over that exact path set and byte total, so a confirmation cannot authorise a deletion other than the one that was shown.
records.label: spacr.data_manager#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Nothing is deleted without a plan.  :func:`plan_prune` returns exactly what would go and how much it frees; :func:`prune` refuses to run unless it is handed :attr:`PrunePlan.token`, a digest over that exact path set and byte total, so a confirmation cannot authorise a deletion other than the one that was shown.
records.translation: 계획 없이 삭제되는 것은 없습니다. :func:`plan_prune`은 무엇이 삭제되고 얼마나 확보되는지를 정확히 반환합니다. :func:`prune`은 :attr:`PrunePlan.token`을 받지 않으면 실행을 거부하며, 이 토큰은 그 정확한 경로 집합과 바이트 합계에 대한 다이제스트이므로, 확인이 표시된 것과 다른 삭제를 승인할 수 없습니다.

records.context: Deleting is **count first, delete second, verify**. The tree is re-fingerprinted against the plan before anything is removed; the registry write is a count and a write on one predicate, checked for equality and rolled back on any difference. See :func:`_verified_write`.

records.translation: 삭제는 **먼저 계수하고, 그다음 삭제하고, 검증합니다**. 무엇이든 제거하기 전에 트리의 지문을 계획과 대조하여 다시 계산합니다. 레지스트리 쓰기는 하나의 조건에 대한 계수와 쓰기로 이루어지며, 일치 여부를 확인하고 차이가 있으면 롤백됩니다. :func:`_verified_write`를 참조하십시오.

records.context: **both masks empty** — ``ari = 1.0``, ``iou_matched_fraction = 1.0``, ``mean_matched_iou = nan``. Two models that both say "there is nothing in this microscope field of view" have made the same statement, and that is agreement; the alternative (``nan``) would drop the microscope field of view out of every aggregate, so an empty image data channel would silently shrink the sample. It is counted separately in :attr:`ComparisonReport.n_both_empty` so it can never be mistaken for agreement about objects, and ``mean_matched_iou`` stays ``nan`` because there is no matched pair to take an IoU of.

records.context: A comparison that differs only in an argument the model never sees reports "no difference" and wastes the processing session. On the installed Cellpose 4, these are accepted and then dropped (see :data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS`): ``model_type``, ``diam_mean`` and ``nchan`` at construction, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` at ``eval``, plus spaCR's own ``restore_type``. Every pre-SAM model name resolves to ``cpsam`` too, so "cyto3 versus nuclei" is one model against itself.
records.label: spacr.model_compare#28
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A comparison that differs only in an argument the model never sees reports "no difference" and wastes the run. On the installed Cellpose 4, these are accepted and then dropped (see :data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS`): ``model_type``, ``diam_mean`` and ``nchan`` at construction, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` at ``eval``, plus spaCR's own ``restore_type``. Every pre-SAM model name resolves to ``cpsam`` too, so "cyto3 versus nuclei" is one model against itself.
records.translation: 모델이 전혀 보지 않는 인수만 다른 비교는 "no difference"를 보고하고 실행을 낭비합니다. 설치된 Cellpose 4에서는 다음이 받아들여진 뒤 버려집니다(:data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS` 참조): 생성 시의 ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels``와 ``rescale``(``eval`` 시점), 그리고 spaCR 자체의 ``restore_type``. 또한 SAM 이전의 모든 모델 이름은 ``cpsam``으로 해석되므로, "cyto3 versus nuclei"는 한 모델을 자기 자신과 비교하는 것입니다.

The Spacing is built from the SPACE axes only.** A 5-d ngff image has axes ``(t, c, z, y, x)``: the time axis is in seconds, the image data channel axis has no unit at all, and z/y/x are in micrometers. A single ``Spacing`` over all five would have to answer "what unit is this?" with one string, and whatever it answered would be wrong for three of the axes — a stack whose spacing claims ``"um"`` while one of its axes steps in seconds passes the unit check in ``layers.py`` and is then drawn at the wrong scale. So :attr:`OmeZarrImage.spacing` covers z/y/x, and t and c are reported alongside as :class:`Axis` records through :attr:`OmeZarrImage.other_axes`, :attr:`OmeZarrImage.time_axis` and :attr:`OmeZarrImage.channel_axis`. Nothing is lost; the reader does not treat seconds and micrometers as the same kind of number.

records.translation: **1. Spacing은 SPACE 축만으로 만들어집니다.** 5차원 NGFF 이미지의 축은 ``(t, c, z, y, x)``입니다. 시간 축은 초 단위이고, 채널 축은 단위가 전혀 없으며, z/y/x는 마이크로미터 단위입니다. 다섯 축 모두에 대한 하나의 ``Spacing``은 "what unit is this?"에 문자열 하나로 답해야 하며, 무엇으로 답하든 세 축에 대해서는 틀립니다 — 축 하나가 초 단위로 증가하는데 간격은 ``"um"``이라고 주장하는 스택은 ``layers.py``의 단위 검사를 통과한 뒤 잘못된 척도로 그려집니다. 따라서 :attr:`OmeZarrImage.spacing`은 z/y/x를 포함하고, t와 c는 :class:`Axis` 레코드로서 :attr:`OmeZarrImage.other_axes`, :attr:`OmeZarrImage.time_axis`, :attr:`OmeZarrImage.channel_axis`를 통해 함께 보고됩니다. 잃는 것은 없으며, 판독기는 초와 마이크로미터를 같은 종류의 숫자로 취급하지 않습니다.

records.context: **2. Units are translated through an explicit table, and an unknown one is refused.** :data:`NGFF_UNIT_TO_SPACR` is the mapping, written out. A unit that is not in it throws :class:`OmeZarrError`. It would be one line to default to ``"px"`` instead, and that one line is how a 0.65 µm pixel becomes a 0.65 px pixel and every downstream area comes out wrong by a factor of 10^6 — in a column named ``cell_area`` that still looks plausible. The error distinguishes the two cases that need different fixes: a unit NGFF does not define (the file is wrong), and a legal NGFF unit spaCR has no short token for (convert it, e.g. to ``micrometer``).

records.translation: **2. 단위는 명시적 표를 통해 변환되며, 알 수 없는 단위는 거부됩니다.** :data:`NGFF_UNIT_TO_SPACR`가 그 매핑을 명시적으로 적은 것입니다. 여기에 없는 단위는 :class:`OmeZarrError`를 발생시킵니다. 대신 ``"px"``를 기본값으로 쓰는 것은 한 줄이면 되지만, 그 한 줄 때문에 0.65 µm 픽셀이 0.65 px 픽셀이 되고 모든 후속 면적이 10^6배만큼 틀리게 나옵니다 — 그것도 여전히 그럴듯해 보이는 ``cell_area`` 열에서 말입니다. 오류는 서로 다른 해결이 필요한 두 경우를 구별합니다. NGFF가 정의하지 않는 단위(파일이 잘못됨)와, spaCR에 짧은 토큰이 없는 합법적인 NGFF 단위(예: ``micrometer``로 변환하십시오)입니다.

records.context: **3. A missing unit means pixels, and is reported.** An NGFF file whose space axes carry no ``unit`` is legal and common — it is what every tool that never knew the pixel size writes. That reads back as ``units="px"`` with :attr:`OmeZarrImage.units_declared` ``False`` and a :meth:`OmeZarrImage.describe` line that says the file declared none. It is never silently upgraded to µm, and ``"px"`` is never written out as a unit string, because NGFF has no pixel unit: writing a px spacing emits axes with no ``unit``, which is the same convention read back.

records.context: The writer builds a pyramid by **2x block mean over the two fastest-varying space axes** (see :func:`write_ome_zarr`). It is a box filter and **not a Gaussian pyramid**: there is no pre-filter beyond the box, so it aliases where a properly filtered pyramid would not. It is chosen anyway because it is separable, exact, dependency-free, and the same ``local_mean`` the rest of the NGFF ecosystem writes — matching what other viewers produce matters more here than a marginally better kernel. Striding (``downsample="stride"``) is offered and is **mandatory for label/mask arrays**: the mean of labels 3 and 5 is 4, an object that does not exist.

records.translation: 작성기는 **가장 빠르게 변하는 두 공간 축에 대한 2x 블록 평균**으로 피라미드를 만듭니다(:func:`write_ome_zarr` 참조). 이는 박스 필터이며 **가우시안 피라미드가 아닙니다**. 박스 외에 사전 필터가 없으므로, 제대로 필터링된 피라미드라면 생기지 않을 곳에서 앨리어싱이 생깁니다. 그래도 이를 선택한 이유는 분리 가능하고, 정확하며, 의존성이 없고, 나머지 NGFF 생태계가 기록하는 것과 같은 ``local_mean``이기 때문입니다 — 여기서는 약간 더 나은 커널보다 다른 뷰어가 만드는 것과 일치하는 것이 더 중요합니다. 스트라이드 방식(``downsample="stride"``)도 제공되며 **레이블/마스크 배열에는 필수입니다**. 레이블 3과 5의 평균은 4이며, 이는 존재하지 않는 객체입니다.

records.context: Level *k*'s ``scale`` is level 0's ``scale`` multiplied by the cumulative factor 2^k on each downsampled axis. Leaving it at level 0's value is a common NGFF bug — it renders as a pyramid whose coarse levels are a quarter the size of the fine ones and drift off the top-left corner as you zoom. The ``translation`` moves too, and by a different rule per method: a block mean puts the first output element at the *centre* of the block it averaged, half a level-0 pixel in from the edge, so level *k* is translated by ``scale_0 * (2^k - 1) / 2``; a strided level samples element 0 exactly and is not translated at all. Both are written, and asserted in the tests with the numbers spelled out by hand.

records.translation: 레벨 *k*의 ``scale``은 레벨 0의 ``scale``에 다운샘플링된 각 축에서 누적 계수 2^k를 곱한 것입니다. 이를 레벨 0의 값으로 남겨 두는 것은 흔한 NGFF 버그입니다 — 거친 레벨이 세밀한 레벨의 4분의 1 크기로 렌더링되고 확대/축소할 때 왼쪽 위 모서리에서 어긋나는 피라미드가 됩니다. ``translation``도 바뀌며, 방법마다 규칙이 다릅니다. 블록 평균은 첫 번째 출력 요소를 평균한 블록의 *중심*, 즉 가장자리에서 레벨 0 픽셀 절반만큼 안쪽에 두므로 레벨 *k*는 ``scale_0 * (2^k - 1) / 2``만큼 이동됩니다. 스트라이드 레벨은 요소 0을 정확히 샘플링하므로 전혀 이동되지 않습니다. 둘 다 기록되며, 테스트에서 손으로 계산한 숫자로 검증됩니다.

records.context: **Chunked.** The array is stored as a grid of independently compressed blocks, so a 100 GB plate is readable a tile at a time. Metadata queries read no array data: :func:`read_ome_zarr` opens a handful of small JSON files and returns the levels, their shapes, their voxel sizes and their chunk grids without reading any chunk, and :meth:`OmeZarrImage.read` with a ``region=`` decodes only the chunks that region intersects. Every byte of chunk data in the pure-Python path passes through one function, :func:`_read_chunk_bytes`, and ``tests/test_ome_zarr.py`` counts its calls to check that reads are lazy.

records.context: The **chunk codecs** are what need compiled code, so they are what the optional extra provides. This module decodes and encodes chunks compressed with ``zlib``, ``gzip``, ``bz2``, ``lzma`` or stored uncompressed using nothing but the standard library, which is why a spaCR-written OME-Zarr round-trips on a plain ``pip install spacr``. A file compressed with ``blosc``, ``zstd`` or ``lz4`` — the common defaults of other tools — raises :class:`ZarrExtraMissing`, whose message names *the codec that was needed* and the install command, instead of a ``ModuleNotFoundError`` raised deeper in the call stack.

records.context: **The transformations.** Level *k*'s ``scale`` is level 0's multiplied by 2^k on each downsampled axis — writing level 0's scale on every level is a common NGFF bug, and it renders as coarse levels that are a quarter the size of the fine ones and slide off the corner as you zoom. The ``translation`` moves too, and differently per method: a block mean centres its first output element half a level-0 pixel inside the edge, so level *k* gets ``translate_0 + scale_0 * (2^k - 1) / 2``, while a strided level samples element 0 exactly and keeps ``translate_0``.
records.label: spacr.ome_zarr.write_ome_zarr#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The transformations.** Level *k*'s ``scale`` is level 0's multiplied by 2^k on each downsampled axis — writing level 0's scale on every level is a common NGFF bug, and it renders as coarse levels that are a quarter the size of the fine ones and slide off the corner as you zoom. The ``translation`` moves too, and differently per method: a block mean centres its first output element half a level-0 pixel inside the edge, so level *k* gets ``translate_0 + scale_0 * (2^k - 1) / 2``, while a strided level samples element 0 exactly and keeps ``translate_0``.
records.translation: **변환.** 레벨 *k*의 ``scale``은 레벨 0의 값에 다운샘플링된 각 축에서 2^k를 곱한 것입니다 — 모든 레벨에 레벨 0의 척도를 기록하는 것은 흔한 NGFF 버그이며, 거친 레벨이 세밀한 레벨의 4분의 1 크기로 렌더링되고 확대/축소할 때 모서리에서 미끄러져 나갑니다. ``translation``도 바뀌며, 방법마다 다릅니다. 블록 평균은 첫 번째 출력 요소를 가장자리에서 레벨 0 픽셀 절반만큼 안쪽에 중심을 두므로 레벨 *k*는 ``translate_0 + scale_0 * (2^k - 1) / 2``를 받고, 스트라이드 레벨은 요소 0을 정확히 샘플링하므로 ``translate_0``을 유지합니다.

records.context: **Sequencing error** (:func:`misassign_reads`, ``sequencing_error_rate=``). Both packages treat the read fraction as an exact record of which genotypes were in a microplate sample position. Substitution errors, index hopping, PCR chimeras and mismatch-tolerant demultiplexing all credit reads to the wrong gene. Simulating it says the direct dilution is small — but that it silently disables the unidentified-gene check, turning genes that were correctly reported as untested into confident non-hits. On the reference design that costs ten times more than the dilution does. See :func:`misassign_reads`.

Simulating it says the direct dilution is small — but that it silently disables the unidentified-gene check, turning genes that were correctly reported as untested into confident non-hits. records.context: Neither spaCRPower nor the port had this stage, and its absence is optimistic in a specific way: it makes the read fraction an *exact* measure of which genotypes were in a microplate sample position. records.context: Mis-assignment gives a gene phantom reads in microplate sample positions it never entered, so the covariate the model regresses positive counts on is a shrunk-toward-uniform version of the truth. The obvious consequence is regression dilution — an attenuated coefficient and a smaller apparent effect — and measuring it in this simulator says that at realistic rates it is **small**: on the 452-gene reference design, 0.5 % mis-assignment moves the hit/non-hit separation from 0.799 to 0.794 among the genes that were identifiable to begin with. Deep sequencing averages most of it away.

The obvious consequence is regression dilution — an attenuated coefficient and a smaller apparent effect — and measuring it in this simulator says that at realistic rates it is **small**: on the 452-gene reference design, 0.5 % mis-assignment moves the hit/non-hit separation from 0.799 to 0.794 among the genes that were identifiable to begin with. Deep sequencing averages most of it away.
records.translation: 잘못된 할당은 유전자가 들어간 적 없는 웰에 유령 리드를 부여하므로, 모델이 양성 개수를 회귀하는 공변량은 실제 값이 균일 쪽으로 축소된 버전이 됩니다. 명백한 결과는 회귀 희석 — 약화된 계수와 더 작아 보이는 효과 — 이며, 이 시뮬레이터에서 측정하면 현실적인 비율에서는 그것이 **작습니다**. 452개 유전자 기준 설계에서 0.5 % 잘못된 할당은 처음부터 식별 가능했던 유전자들 사이의 히트/비히트 분리를 0.799에서 0.794로 바꿉니다. 깊은 시퀀싱은 그 대부분을 평균으로 상쇄합니다.

records.context: The consequence that is *not* obvious, and is much larger, is what it does to the genes that were never testable. A gene that landed in every microplate sample position, or in none, has a constant read-fraction column; its coefficient is confounded with the intercept and ``power_model.prepare_model_data`` reports it as unidentified rather than as a non-hit. That check is what keeps a thin design from reporting untestable genes as negative results, and mis-assignment defeats it, because phantom reads give every gene a covariate that *varies*. On the same reference design, 0.5 % error takes the scored library from 317 genes to all 452: the 135 genes that were correctly flagged "untested" become scored non-hits with a covariate made entirely of noise, and the screening experiment-wide separation falls from 0.799 to 0.723 — fourteen times the direct dilution, and all of it from a safeguard being switched off rather than from any loss of signal.

records.translation: 명백하지 *않으면서* 훨씬 더 큰 결과는 처음부터 검사할 수 없었던 유전자에 미치는 영향입니다. 모든 웰에 들어갔거나 어느 웰에도 들어가지 않은 유전자는 리드 비율 열이 상수이며, 그 계수는 절편과 교란되므로 ``power_model.prepare_model_data``는 이를 비히트가 아니라 식별 불가로 보고합니다. 이 검사는 빈약한 설계가 검사할 수 없는 유전자를 음성 결과로 보고하지 않도록 막아 주며, 잘못된 할당은 이를 무력화합니다. 유령 리드가 모든 유전자에 *변하는* 공변량을 주기 때문입니다. 같은 기준 설계에서 0.5 % 오류는 점수가 매겨지는 라이브러리를 317개에서 452개 전부로 늘립니다. "untested"로 올바르게 표시되던 135개 유전자가 전적으로 잡음으로 이루어진 공변량을 가진 점수 매겨진 비히트가 되며, 스크린 전체 분리는 0.799에서 0.723으로 떨어집니다 — 직접 희석의 열네 배이며, 그 전부가 신호 손실이 아니라 안전장치가 꺼진 데서 비롯됩니다.

records.context: If ``var <= mean``. The negative binomial is over-dispersed by construction: at ``var == mean`` the size parameter is ``+inf`` (the Poisson limit, which numpy cannot sample as an NB), and below it the size is negative. R's ``assertthat`` allows ``var == mean`` and then hands ``Inf`` to ``rnbinom``, which returns ``NA`` — a whole column of silently missing counts. Use :func:`sample_count_mean_variance` if you want the equi- and under-dispersed cases handled for you.

records.source: If ``var <= mean``. The negative binomial is over-dispersed by construction: at ``var == mean`` the size parameter is ``+inf`` (the Poisson limit, which numpy cannot sample as an NB), and below it the size is negative. R's ``assertthat`` allows ``var == mean`` and then hands ``Inf`` to ``rnbinom``, which returns ``NA`` — a whole column of silently missing counts. records.context: ``gene_abundance_alpha`` controls how *even* the library is, and it runs the opposite way from intuition: large alpha gives every gene about ``1/n`` of the pool, alpha near zero concentrates the whole pool on one gene, and ``alpha = 1`` corresponds to a Gini index of 0.5. The real *T. gondii* screening experiment this simulator was fitted to came out at ``alpha = 0.6``, i.e. quite skewed — which is why some genes in it never reached enough microplate sample positions to be callable at all.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_library#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``gene_abundance_alpha`` controls how *even* the library is, and it runs the opposite way from intuition: large alpha gives every gene about ``1/n`` of the pool, alpha near zero concentrates the whole pool on one gene, and ``alpha = 1`` corresponds to a Gini index of 0.5. The real *T. gondii* screen this simulator was fitted to came out at ``alpha = 0.6``, i.e. quite skewed — which is why some genes in it never reached enough wells to be callable at all.
records.translation: ``gene_abundance_alpha``는 라이브러리가 얼마나 *고른지*를 제어하며, 직관과 반대로 작동합니다. 알파가 크면 모든 유전자가 풀의 약 ``1/n``을 가지고, 알파가 0에 가까우면 풀 전체가 한 유전자에 집중되며, ``alpha = 1``은 지니 지수 0.5에 해당합니다. 이 시뮬레이터가 적합된 실제 *T. gondii* 스크린은 ``alpha = 0.6``으로 나왔으며, 즉 상당히 치우쳐 있습니다 — 그래서 그 스크린의 일부 유전자는 판정할 수 있을 만큼 충분한 웰에 전혀 도달하지 못했습니다.

records.context: Both imaging and sequencing plates originate from *one shared source*: the spot plate. Thus the genotypes in a well are one physical fact observed twice. Each stage uses an independent random stream. Changing the imaging-cell count therefore leaves sequencing draws unchanged. This separation allows meaningful comparison across a sweep of parameter values. Otherwise each point would also contain unrelated randomization.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_screen#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The imaging and sequencing plates are both simulated from the *same* spot plate — which genotypes are in a well is one physical fact, observed twice. Each stage draws from its own spawned child stream, so changing the number of imaging cells does not shift the sequencing draws; that independence is what makes a parameter sweep interpretable, since otherwise every point on the sweep would differ by an unrelated re-randomisation as well as by the parameter.
records.translation: 이미징 플레이트와 시퀀싱 플레이트는 모두 *같은* 스폿 플레이트에서 시뮬레이션됩니다 — 웰에 어떤 유전자형이 있는지는 하나의 물리적 사실이며, 두 번 관측될 뿐입니다. 각 단계는 자체적으로 분기된 자식 스트림에서 추출하므로, 이미징 세포 수를 바꿔도 시퀀싱 추출이 이동하지 않습니다. 이러한 독립성 덕분에 매개변수 스윕을 해석할 수 있습니다. 그렇지 않으면 스윕의 모든 지점이 매개변수뿐 아니라 무관한 재무작위화에 의해서도 달라지기 때문입니다.

records.context: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screening experiment near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screening experiment" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.

records.source: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screen near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screen" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.
records.translation: **R 원본과 다른 두 가지이며, 둘 다 의도된 것입니다.** 업스트림은 ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))``를 ``group_by(well)`` 안에서 계산하므로 ``nrow``는 *라이브러리 크기*입니다. 유전자 452개와 ``n_reads_total = 128318``이면 웰당 284개의 리드가 되며, 실제 스크린은 3e4 근처입니다. 이 매개변수는 한 비네트에서는 "total reads in the screen"으로, 다른 비네트에서는 "geometric mean of well reads"로 문서화되어 있습니다. 이 함수는 ``n_reads_per_well``을 모호함 없이 받고 ``n_reads_total``을 유도된 합계로 보고합니다. 둘째, 업스트림의 보호 조건 ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)``은 ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)``로 계산되는 반면 항아리는 요소별 ``round(cells * pcr)``입니다. 둘은 반올림 때문에 달라지며, 추출이 항아리에 든 것보다 많은 공을 요청할 수 있습니다. 여기서는 보호 조건을 항아리 자체에서 계산합니다.

records.context: **Probabilities above 1 are clipped, with a warning.** The Bernoulli probability is a product of two independently drawn quantities and nothing constrains it to ``[0, 1]``; at ``alpha = 0.6`` the most abundant gene's share times a ``mu = 4.6`` microplate sample position factor exceeds 1 routinely. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` there and carries on. This clips to 1 and emits one :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning` carrying the number of clipped cells and the largest offending probability, because a clipped run has a realised genes-per-microplate sample position *below* the one that was requested — the answer is still usable, but not for the parameter value written on it.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_spot_plate#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Probabilities above 1 are clipped, with a warning.** The Bernoulli probability is a product of two independently drawn quantities and nothing constrains it to ``[0, 1]``; at ``alpha = 0.6`` the most abundant gene's share times a ``mu = 4.6`` well factor exceeds 1 routinely. R's ``rbinom`` returns ``NA`` there and carries on. This clips to 1 and emits one :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning` carrying the number of clipped cells and the largest offending probability, because a clipped run has a realised genes-per-well *below* the one that was requested — the answer is still usable, but not for the parameter value written on it.
records.translation: **1을 넘는 확률은 경고와 함께 잘립니다.** Bernoulli 확률은 독립적으로 추출된 두 양의 곱이며, 이를 ``[0, 1]``로 제한하는 것은 없습니다. ``alpha = 0.6``에서는 가장 풍부한 유전자의 몫에 ``mu = 4.6`` 웰 계수를 곱하면 흔히 1을 넘습니다. R의 ``rbinom``은 그 경우 ``NA``를 반환하고 계속 진행합니다. 이 함수는 1로 잘라 내고, 잘린 셀의 수와 가장 큰 문제 확률을 담은 :class:`AbundanceClippedWarning`을 한 번 발생시킵니다. 잘린 실행은 실제 웰당 유전자 수가 요청한 값*보다 낮기* 때문입니다 — 답은 여전히 사용할 수 있지만, 그 위에 적힌 매개변수 값에 대한 답은 아닙니다.
